cbv9:0.1: The Discourse on how Friendliness Meditation should be Done
cbv9:2.1: Because of the power of that (safeguard) the yakkhas could not make fearful (sights) appear,
cbv9:2.2: by practising that diligently night and day
cbv9:2.3: he sleeps happily, and while sleeping does not see anything bad -
cbv9:2.4: it is endowed with such qualities, we will recite that safeguard.
